thread:
incident-bot: [PagerDuty] P0 — High GPU queue growth detected in asia-southeast3 (redwood-inference). Autoscaler failing due to cloud GPU quota limits. Service: /v1/generate (text-gen). Impact: elevated latency and 429s.

maya.r: i'm on this. seeing queue spike on pool-gpu-a, autoscaler logs show repeated quotaExceeded around 03:12 UTC.
adrian.w: confirmed. GCP reports GPU quota for region asia-southeast3 at 100/100. attempts to create instances returning QUOTA_EXCEEDED.
sophie.l: customer impact summary (last 10m): 18% increase in p95 latency, ~1% 429/503s, affected: several beta customers and some PLG flows.

ops-oncall: @maya.r can you paste the autoscaler tail and the nodegroup error?
maya.r: logs pasted below:
```
autoscaler-controller: error creating instance: Quota 'NVIDIA_TESLA_T4' exceeded for region asia-southeast3.
scale_request: wanted 6 gpus, available 0.
Retrying provisioning but quota error persists.
```

adrian.w: cloud error snippet: `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: projects/56789/regions/asia-southeast3: Insufficient GPU quota to fulfill request`
infra-jen: we don't have spare GPUs in that region for the project. options: shift traffic, evict non-prod, or request emergency quota from GCP.

sophie.l: what's the quickest way to reduce customer impact while we wait on GCP?

ops-oncall: short-term mitigations proposed:
- divert a portion of new requests for the heavy model to us-west1 via routing rules
- lower batch sizes and fall back to quantized-small model for non-critical traffic
- scale down non-prod/dedicated test pools to free GPUs immediately
- open an expedited GCP quota request

maya.r: applied a temporary route: `route update gen-large --region-preference=us-west1 --weight=25` (25% diverted).
adrian.w: started eviction of non-prod deployment to free ~12 GPUs: `kubectl scale deploy/nonprod-gpu --replicas=0` — ETA ~7m.

incident-bot: Incident timeline updated. Tags: region=asia-southeast3, impact=partial, severity=P0.

infra-jen: opened GCP support case INC-789321 / gcp-req-5543 requesting a quota bump + zone capacity check. They say standard expedite window is 2–4 hours. not immediate.
sophie.l: sending out customer notifications to affected accounts; putting note on status page.

ops-oncall: monitoring queue length/429 rate. if diversion doesn't bring queue <200 in 10m we'll increase to 50% and enable model fallback.
maya.r: after diversion + evictions queue dropped from 420 -> 215 in 6m. 429s down to ~0.6%. improvement but still elevated.
adrian.w: GCP support update: they can raise quota to 150 within 2–4h; cannot commit to sub-hour emergency quota.

sophie.l: summary for handoff in 30m:
- keep diversion at 25% (increase to 50% if queue rises)
- complete non-prod eviction until we free target_gpus=12
- continue GCP ticket updates and escalate with account if needed
- customer comms: status page + targeted messages to top 5 affected customers

ops-oncall: handing off to @infra-jen at 03:45 UTC — infra-jen please ack.
infra-jen: ack. i'll watch metrics and raise diversion or shift more traffic cross-region if we see backsliding. i'll also coordinate freeing up reserved capacity where possible.

incident-bot: Handoff recorded. New on-call: infra-jen. Thread remains open until queue stable for 1h or quota increase confirmed. :white_check_mark:

sophie.l: post-mortem owners assigned: infra-jen (capacity & quota), adrian.w (autoscaler logic & better failure handling), maya.r (routing fallback & runbooks). we'll schedule follow-up retro.

maya.r: one more note — recommend a mitigation playbook: auto-diversion to alternate region + model-fallback tier when autoscaler detects quota errors. saves manual triage next time.
adrian.w: noted. also raising a ticket to improve autoscaler error classification so quota hits trigger faster diversion.
sophie.l: thanks team — keeping page open until infra confirms stable for 60m. will send status update in 15m. :thumbsup:
